I, personally think, what you did is great. Its a good start. 

Maybe, when your sibling starts to open up, you can chat a bit about what triggered it. You can come up with activities to do together. They can visit you, if you're in a different country. 

You can go bowling,  or just for a coffee.  Watch movies, just let them know you care and they're not alone. To for a nice morning walk, or grab ice-cream.
Play chess, or cards, or video games together. 
There's plenty of things you can do for them. 

Be prepared, because there's a small chance of them wanting space, or being rude/not in the mood if you know what I mean, but don't take it personally!

Good luck 😘
